findings.detail: X02 applies an income-bearing private-credit rate requirement to dash/dash commitment or fee-adjustment rows with no funded par and negative carrying amounts.

rationale: Raw SOI rows show that the missing values faithfully reproduce filer dashes in both rate columns. The cited rows have no funded par and instead carry negative cost and/or fair-value adjustments, while neighboring funded term loans disclose both reference spread and interest rate. X02 therefore mis-scopes these non-income-bearing adjustment lines as ordinary private-credit positions; the extraction is source-faithful. No valuation anchor is applicable to this single-cell rate-presence rule.
